ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Delphi World Money Limited announced the re-appointment of Mr. Hariprasad Meenoth Panichikkil as Whole-Time Director for a further five-year term, effective February 2027. A significant red flag and material impact is the explicit statement that this Whole-Time Director role will be without remuneration, which is highly unusual for a full-time executive position and warrants scrutiny regarding his actual compensation source or the company's executive pay structure. The document also outlines routine corporate governance matters, including the scheduling of the 41st Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026.
